title: Session handoff: glyph-cli 1f23474d (renewal boundary after GCLI-19)
description:
Session handoff for the glyph-cli worker at its renewal boundary, 2026-11-17T06:47Z, written after opum-ai/glyph-cli#68 landed. STATE AT WRITE: origin/dev 1f234747dbff52112788ecec5e97ab4fe2456471 (squash of #68), origin/main 63577d4318f30f9c34ecd392b5db874482ad0bf7 — dev is 9 commits ahead, no promotion was taken this session. Working tree clean; no open pull requests; no task In Progress; one task carries the hold label (GCLI-18).

LANDED THIS SESSION, all through reviewed PRs into dev: GCLI-14 diff-path unquoting (#62, one review round); GCLI-13 one argument scanner (#64, three rounds); GCLI-15 review worktrees kept out of discovery (#66, one round); GCLI-19 documentation and spec corrections (#68, five rounds). Tracker-only PRs #61 (GCLI-18 hold label), #63 (GCLI-14 verdict and follow-ups), #65 (GCLI-13 verdict), #67 (GCLI-15 verdict and nits).

NEXT, in the approved order and one PR at a time: GCLI-21, then GCLI-11 (slice 3), then GCLI-12 (slice 4). Each stops at a green head with a detached review worktree at .claude/worktrees/review-<pr>-<short sha>, the head SHA messaged to the leader, and no merge until the verdict is relayed. GCLI-18 IS HELD (label `hold`) until the leader sends a brief; do not start it. GCLI-11, 12 and 14 were predicted on src/ paths; the DEC-182 (1) fence still applies — a change needing any of those path classes or adding a dependency stops and reports before committing.

FOLLOW-UPS FILED THIS SESSION, none admitted: GCLI-26 (GCLI-14 test hardening: pin core.quotePath, literal unquoteGitPath test, fatal UTF-8 decode), GCLI-27 (parseDiff reads -- / ++ content lines as headers, and trims real trailing whitespace), GCLI-28 (scanner edges: a -- after unknown or value options, a lone dash; plus renaming the -vh positive-control test), GCLI-29 (pin the worktree ignore's root-only scope; reproduce a real worktree .git gitfile), GCLI-30 (a backslash-named source file is silently unindexable because TypeScript normalises separators), GCLI-31 (one over-long ADR 0003 line).

OPEN DESIGN DECISION: GCLI-19's item 4 hashing arm — bringing the outside-root inputs into computeRefKey instead of scoping the promise — was left open by ruling; the leader's successor will put it to opum-doc. Do not decide it in a session.

MECHANICS THAT COST TIME THIS SESSION: quest and lore are 0.14.1 under ~/.nvm/versions/node/v24.22.2/bin; a renewed process may have neither on PATH, and DEC-266 says prepend that directory in each call — no symlink, do not touch the nvm default. Record every reviewer verdict verbatim on the task with the model and head, demote with `quest task demote --to "In Progress"` (a plain status edit refuses that transition), and re-complete in the same PR. CI runs can take a minute to register after a push; check `check-runs` for the exact full SHA rather than reading an empty `gh run list` as no run. The dev push run after each merge is the last gate — confirm it green before reporting the merge. .claude/worktrees/ is gitignored as of GCLI-15, so worktrees no longer appear as untracked files.

WORKTREES: every review-* checkout under .claude/worktrees/ is left in place per DEC-208 and LCLI-740 — do not remove, deregister or prune any of them. The successor restores from this task and the repository, not from the restart cursor.
